mechanism: Both drugs prolong QT interval and inhibit cardiac potassium channels, with additive risk of arrhythmias; diltiazem may increase moxifloxacin levels through CYP3A4 inhibition.
action: Monitor ECG and QTc interval; consider alternative antibiotic if possible; ensure electrolyte monitoring (K+, Mg2+) and avoid other QT-prolonging agents.
